test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-2 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Partner-Gateway-066
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-2.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: authenticators are centrally managed, rotated, revoked on termination, and protected from disclosure. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
